# bash_allow.txt — commands that MUST end in Allow under tier 1+2 only
# (no LLM, no cache, no legacy). One command per line. Lines starting
# with # and blank lines are ignored.
#
# These exercise the deterministic instant_allow rules. Every command
# here is a "shape that's anchored, no shell trickery, in the allow
# program list". Catches regressions when allow rules tighten or
# break.

# --- POSIX read-only family ---
ls
ls -la
ls -la /tmp
cat /etc/hosts
head -10 /var/log/system.log
tail -5 /tmp/test.log
wc -l /tmp/test.log
grep foo /tmp/test.log
grep -r foo /tmp
find /tmp -type f
find /tmp -name '*.log'
which python3
whereis ls
file /tmp/test
stat /tmp/test
du -sh /tmp
df -h
printenv PATH
echo hello
echo "hello world"
echo hello world
date
pwd
whoami
hostname
uname -a
id

# --- Text/data inspection ---
jq .
yq .
cmp /tmp/a /tmp/b
diff /tmp/a /tmp/b
xxd /bin/ls
od -c /tmp/file
hexdump /tmp/file

# --- Git read-only subcommands ---
git status
git log
git log --oneline
git log -n 5
git diff
git diff main
git diff HEAD~1
git show
git show HEAD
git branch
git branch -a
git remote
git remote -v
git blame /tmp/file
git rev-parse HEAD
git ls-files
git ls-tree HEAD
git describe
git config user.name

# deep for anchored_command). gcloud calls fall through to the LLM

# --- make read-only targets ---

# --- step 1 regression: gh reads still instant-allow via gh-readonly ---
gh pr view 42
gh pr list
gh issue list
gh repo view foo/bar
gh api /user
gh api -X GET /user

# --- gh api PR review and comment creation (AllowPathSuffixes) ---
gh api repos/foo/bar/pulls/28/reviews --method POST --input /tmp/review.json
gh api repos/foo/bar/pulls/28/comments --method POST --input /tmp/comment.json

# --- gh pr review --approve: approving a PR is non-destructive ---
gh pr review --approve 42
gh pr review 42 --approve
gh pr review 42 -a
gh pr review 42 --approve -b "lgtm"
gh pr review 42 --approve --body "lgtm"

# --- step 3: git config reads (stay instant_allow via git-readonly) ---
git config

git config --get-all remote.origin.url
git config --get-regexp ^alias
git config --show-origin user.email

# --- step 3: git remote reads (stay instant_allow via git-readonly) ---
git remote
git remote -v
git remote show origin
git remote get-url origin

# --- cd-prefixed compound commands (subagent patterns) ---
cd /tmp && git status
cd /Users/robin/Documents/code/ai-site-gen && git log --oneline -5
cd /tmp/repo && git diff HEAD
cd /tmp && git log --oneline -5 && echo "---" && git show HEAD
cd /tmp && ls -la
cd /tmp && cat file.txt
cd /tmp && echo hello
cd /tmp && git log --oneline | head -5
cd /tmp && git show abc123 --stat | head -10
cd /tmp && ls -la | grep foo
cd /tmp && git log --oneline | wc -l
cd /Users/robin/Documents/code/ai-site-gen && git log --oneline -5 && echo "---" && git show e48ecd1 --stat | head -10
cd /tmp && gh pr list
cd /Users/robin/Documents/code/cto-as-a-service && git log --oneline --since="2026-06-20" 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd /Users/robin/Documents/code/ai-site-gen && gcloud builds list --project=content-gen-484211 --limit=5 2>/dev/null | head -20

# --- gcloud config readonly ---
gcloud config get-value project 2>/dev/null
gcloud config get-value account 2>/dev/null
gcloud config list
gcloud config get-value project 2>/dev/null; gcloud config get-value account 2>/dev/null; gcloud auth list 2>/dev/null | head -5

# --- pipeline-readonly: pipe tails to safe sinks ---
git log | head
git log | head -10
git log --oneline -5 | tail
ls -la | head -5
ls /tmp | wc -l
ls /tmp | grep foo
cat /etc/hosts | grep localhost
git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD 2>&1
git log --oneline 2>&1 | head -20
git show HEAD --stat | head -30
find . -name "*.go" | head -20
find /tmp -name "*.log" | head

# --- pipeline-readonly: compound && / ; / || of safe reads ---
ls /tmp && cat /tmp/foo
ls; cat /tmp/foo
git log --oneline -5 && git branch
git log -5 && echo "---" && git status
echo "---" ; git status
git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD && git status

# --- pipeline-readonly: claude-guard with pipe + stderr merge ---
claude-guard explain --last-n 50 2>&1 | head -200
claude-guard stats | head -20

# --- pipeline-readonly: 2>/dev/null output suppression (devops walkthrough) ---
gcloud scheduler jobs list --project=content-gen-484211 --format="table(name,state,lastAttemptTime)" 2>/dev/null | head -30
gcloud pubsub subscriptions list --project=content-gen-484211 --filter="deadLetterPolicy:*" --format="value(name)" 2>/dev/null | head -10
gcloud logging read "severity>=ERROR" --project=content-gen-484211 --limit=20 2>/dev/null | tail -50
gcloud sql instances list --project=content-gen-484211 --format="table(name,state,region)" 2>/dev/null | head -20
gh search prs --owner taufinity --merged --limit 10 --json number,title,author,repository,mergedAt,url 2>/dev/null
gcloud run services list --project=content-gen-484211 --format="table(name,region)" 2>/dev/null | head -20
git log --oneline -10 2>/dev/null | head -10
gh search prs --owner taufinity --merged --limit=10 --json number,title,author,mergedAt,url,repository 2>/dev/null | python3 /private/tmp/claude-501/scratchpad/check-team-prs.py

# --- sed-readonly: -n + print-only script, no side-effecting commands ---
sed -n '60,100p' /tmp/file
sed -n '10p' /tmp/file
sed -n '1,50p' /tmp/file
sed -n '/foo/p' /tmp/file

# --- posix-readonly: dir (GNU coreutils ls alias) ---
dir
dir /tmp

# --- loop-readonly: for-loop over literal tokens, body is a read-only call ---
for id in 19 20 21; do git status; done
for i in 1 2 3; do echo $i; done
for i in 1 2 3; do echo ${i}; done
for f in /tmp/a /tmp/b; do cat "$f"; done
for i in 1; do git log --oneline -5; done

# --- blocker 3: ssh-add regression — ssh family still reads keys ---

# --- curl to trusted domain (CurlToDomain rule) ---
# Simple GET
curl -s "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/sites/2/settings/ai"
# GET with headers
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer mytoken" "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/dashboards/vp-resultaten/data"
# PUT (mutation — normal operational work)
curl -s -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer mytoken" -H "Content-Type: application/json" "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/sites/2/settings/ai" -d '{"system_prompt": "test"}'
# POST
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer token123" -H "Content-Type: application/json" "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/widgets/17/test" -d '{"message": "hello"}'
# PATCH
curl -s -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer token123" "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/sites/2/settings" -d '{"key": "value"}'
# With X-Organization-ID header
curl -s -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer token123" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Organization-ID: 17" "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/sites/2/settings/ai" -d '{"temperature": 0.65}'
# URL with port
curl -s "https://studio.taufinity.io:443/api/sites/2/settings"
# URL with credentials in URL (host parsing must strip userinfo)
curl -s "https://user:pass@studio.taufinity.io/api/sites/2"
# Compound: curl with pipe to jq (common pattern)
curl -s "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/sites/2/settings" | jq .
# Compound: curl PUT with pipe to jq
curl -s -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/json" "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/sites/2/settings/ai" -d '{"temperature": 0.7}' | jq '{success}'
# Compound: curl with 2>&1 redirect
curl -s "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/sites/2" 2>&1
# Compound: curl piped to jq then head
curl -s "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/dashboards" | jq '.[] | .name' | head -5
# Compound: TOKEN=$(cmd) && curl — token fetched locally, curl to trusted domain
TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/token.txt) && curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/sites/2/settings"
# Compound: TOKEN=$(cmd) && curl PUT with pipe to jq
TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/token.txt) && curl -s -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/sites/2/settings/ai" -d '{"temperature": 0.7}' | jq .
# Compound: assignment && curl POST
API_KEY=$(printenv TAUFINITY_API_KEY) && curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" "https://studio.taufinity.io/api/widgets/17/test" -d '{"message": "hello"}'

# --- curl to localhost (local dev servers are operator-owned) ---
# Simple GET to localhost
curl -s "http://localhost:8090/api/health"
# GET with port
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/api/status"
# POST to localhost (mutation — local dev is safe)
curl -s -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" "http://localhost:8090/api/widgets" -d '{"name": "test"}'
# PUT to localhost
curl -s -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/json" "http://localhost:8090/api/sites/1/settings" -d '{"key": "value"}'
# localhost with pipe to jq
curl -s "http://localhost:8090/api/sites" | jq '.[] | .name'
# localhost https (self-signed cert scenarios)
curl -s "https://localhost:8443/api/health"

# git push (non-force) — now handled by Tier 2.7 (push-safe) not instant_allow
# In tests: shell commands fail gracefully → score=0 → push-safe auto-allow
# git push --force: Tier 1 deny (in bash_deny.txt); git push --force-with-lease: LLM
git push
git push origin feature-branch
git push origin v1.2.3
# cd + push: goes to LLM for project-context judgment (removed from allow corpus)
